transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Thanks for joining, everyone. Marco, welcome - good to have you here.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: Marco Ruiz, I run security at Acme. Priya asked me to join because the EU rollout moves warehouse data for our EU entity.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: For any vendor touching that data I need to see your SOC2 Type II report and your latest pen-test summary before I can sign off.

transcript.speaker: speaker_05
transcript.text: We can share both as soon as the mutual NDA is countersigned.

transcript.speaker: speaker_03
transcript.text: Fine. Once my team has gone through them, we can talk about a review session.

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: Commercially we're ready; security sign-off is the last gate before signature.

transcript.speaker: speaker_04
transcript.text: Berlin is still targeting go-live before the January peak, so timing matters for us.

transcript.speaker: speaker_01
transcript.text: Understood. I'll send the NDA over tomorrow morning and get the security package to Marco as soon as it's signed.

transcript.speaker: speaker_02
transcript.text: And please keep me on the thread - I'm still your point of contact for the commercial side.
